name: Network Node In-Degree Centrality and Influence Ranking
description: Social network influence and API hub criticality are determined by node in-degree centrality (number of inbound links from distinct entities).
prompt:
Social network influence and API hub criticality are determined by node in-degree centrality (number of inbound links from distinct entities).

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: influencer_id, in_degree_centrality, influence_rank.
Results should be ordered as specified.
setup_sql:
CREATE TABLE network_follows (
                follower_id INT,
                target_user_id INT
            );
            INSERT INTO network_follows VALUES
                (101, 1), (102, 1), (103, 1), (104, 1), -- Node 1 has 4 followers
                (101, 2), (102, 2),                     -- Node 2 has 2 followers
                (101, 3);                               -- Node 3 has 1 follower
golden_sql:
-- Compute in-degree centrality and influence rank
            SELECT 
                target_user_id AS influencer_id,
                COUNT(DISTINCT follower_id) AS in_degree_centrality,
                DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT follower_id) DESC) AS influence_rank
            FROM network_follows
            GROUP BY target_user_id
            ORDER BY influence_rank;
why_it_fails: Counting total edges without filtering distinct source nodes allows a single spammer to inflate influencer metrics.
